title: Choose ScholarKey's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Departures Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Departures Board
options.lineage: Solari split-flap departure boards and airport wayfinding signage
options.thesis: Every diploma is a departure: the board flips each check to VERIFIED, row by row, in public.
options.viewport: A full-width split-flap board heads the page: the ScholarKey line flips in, a white boarding-pass slot reads 'Drop a diploma PDF to verify', and a yellow signage panel points institutions to 'Issue credentials'.
options.risk: Split-flap is a known novelty; it turns gimmick if flaps move without real events or the board swallows body text.

raised.raise: One character-cell grid: every flap, label and numeral on the board snaps to it; nothing floats.
States print themselves: status is flap text in its row, never a pill, toast or badge.
Running order is visible: every check and section carries a code (SK 01, GATE 2) like a flight number.
One calm white panel: the boarding-pass drop slot is the only white surface on the board.
Blank at rest: flaps move only for real events, never as ambient decoration.
Measured rows: each check reports real numbers (ms, bytes hashed, block height) in tabular figures.

options.label: Chromatic Interference
options.lineage: Caracas kinetic art: Cruz-Diez physichromies and the Maiquetía airport floor
options.thesis: Truth resolves when you look closely: fine-line colour fields that settle into a verdict, from the art of Caracas.
options.viewport: A white page cut by a band of dense vertical colour lines; the headline in a plain grotesk, the drop zone a gap in the lines that turns solid green when a diploma verifies.
options.risk: Fine-line moiré fights readability and projector scaling, and it leans on a protected artist's language: it must stay a grammar, never a copy.

options.label: ASCII Live Render
options.thesis: The diploma re-rendered as glyph density; verification sharpens the image.
options.viewport: A diploma made of characters fills the screen and sharpens as checks pass.
options.case: Fuses poorly: registrars and recruiters do not see themselves in hacker glyph art, and the verdict reads as a visual effect.
options.kept: One strict character grid owning the whole board.
options.risk: Reads as a developer toy, close to the crypto look the brief rules out.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: Verification as a live transcript printing each check on glass.
options.viewport: An 80-column transcript where each check types itself out.
options.case: Clear as a log, but it is exactly the neon-on-black Web3 look the brief rejects, and recruiters do not live in terminals.
options.kept: System states print themselves instead of appearing as chrome.

options.label: Session Title Card
options.thesis: Each credential is an episode: hard-cut colour fields and colliding titles.
options.viewport: SCHOLARKEY crashes across a mustard field sliced by a teal bar.
options.case: Memorable for judges, foreign to registrars; style overwhelms the yes/no a verifier needs.
options.kept: A visible running order: numbering as structure.
options.risk: Fan-culture costume on a trust product.

options.label: Festival Hoarding
options.thesis: A loud cut-paper collage with one calm ticket panel on top.
options.viewport: A dense collage with a white finder card for the PDF drop.
options.case: Festive energy contradicts the calm certainty verification needs; audience fit is weak.
options.kept: One calm white panel as the only luxury on a busy plane.
options.risk: Noise where trust needs a clear signal.

options.label: Bioluminescent Wake
options.lineage: plankton glowing in a night sea
options.thesis: Every verification leaves a wake of light across a dark field.
options.viewport: A black field where dropping a PDF draws a glowing trail to the verdict.
options.case: Beautiful but it reads as crypto glow and explains nothing about why the document is authentic.
options.kept: Darkness reclaims everything at rest: motion only for real events.
options.risk: Near-black plus glowing accent: the rejected look.

options.label: Power-Hammer Forge
options.lineage: blacksmith forging under a power hammer
options.thesis: Issuance as forging: each blow a step, measured and registered.
options.viewport: One blow per row: sign, seal, anchor, each with measured force values.
options.case: Strong process metaphor, but heavy industry is foreign to academia and verification.
options.kept: Tabular measured values on every step.
options.risk: Brutal tone on a document people are proud of.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean trust SaaS page: verify academic credentials instantly.
canonCard.viewport: Centred headline over an upload box, three feature cards below, logos strip.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every credential startup by design.
